description: Role roster for OS-orchestrated role sessions (DevOS SPEC §3.1 rev 2026-07-31). Two sessions run per work item: a build session (understand, plan, code, test, fix, commit/push/draft the PR body) and a fresh, adversarial, report-only review session. The five nautical names (Navigator, Shipwright, Lookout, Warden, Harbormaster) are display phases only — NOT sessions and NOT agents — surfaced via each role's `phases[]`. An external orchestrator (the Bridge) reads this roster, spawns each role in pipeline order, and enforces gates. Handoff between roles = the harness's existing artifacts in the story workspace `tasks/stories/<id>/`. Every value in this roster is argv data, never shell text: a consumer spawning a process from `model`/`effort` must pass them as an argument array, never interpolate them into a shell string (the model id `claude-opus-5[1m]` contains glob-significant brackets).
